Australia to Export Uranium to India After Longstanding Agreement

Australia has agreed to commence uranium exports to India, concluding a lengthy period of negotiation and delay. This development follows an agreement signed between the two nations, with the specifics of the arrangement reportedly linked to the 'Shanti Act'. The deal's finalization comes despite India not being a signatory to the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty (NPT).
